lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\UpgradeAppChecker\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

places: lib/Service/CompatibilityService.php:21 OCP\App\IAppManager::getInstalledApps(): deprecated since Nextcloud 32; Use either self::getEnabledApps or self::getEnabledAppsForUser
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 30 to 34. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/Service/CompatibilityService.php:21 OCP\App\IAppManager::getInstalledApps(): deprecated since Nextcloud 32; Use either self::getEnabledApps or self::getEnabledAppsForUser

1 timed job does not say whether it is time sensitive. A job that sets TIME_INSENSITIVE with setTimeSensitivity() is moved to the maintenance window of the server; whether a job is heavy enough for that only its maintainer knows.

The app reads and writes its app config in 6 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
